title: Knight of the Willblade/Quotes
summary:
"Divine Mirror Kagami... With this, the Huntik Foundation will pay for what they did to the Professor." Hoffman

"I wouldn't make a move if I were you. You're outnumbered." Dante Vale to Suits

"In my day, cowards like you would have never been allowed in the Organization."
- Hoffman to his Suits

"If we follow, they will pick us off again."
- Hoffman to Wilder, (Knight of the Willblade)

"Please, King Basilisk."
- Zhalia, visibly emotionally injured right before invoking King Basilisk to save Dante

"Now, where was I?"
- Dante after being turned back from stone

"Now that the kids are put to bed let's see what I can do with this so-called 'Willblade'" 
- Wilder

"You're dangerous with that letter opener."
 - Wilder to Lok Lambert on the latter having grabbed the Willblade

"Lok's amazing, but no one can beat three Titans and a master Seeker at once."
- Cherit on Lok fighting Wilder and his Titans
